name: Bustarviejo (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided by a line of many sharp points, white above and red below, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Bustarviejo (two oxen on red above a bridge on white).
history: The arms and flag of Bustarviejo are regulated by decree 30/1987 of 9 April on the adoption of flags and arms by the municipalities of the Community of Madrid; the process lasted from February 1989 to May 1993 owing to a series of changes to the arms. On 12 February 1991 the council agreed to adopt arms and flag identical to the present ones except that they had two cows instead of two oxen, and on 26 July of the same year a new council halted the file to revise the design before its final approval.
